title: New today + your top 10
intro: Six new leads today, best first, then your top 10 from earlier (all still open when I re-checked them today). LA roles lead and anything outside LA is labeled. None of the new postings mentions travel to Paris, so I haven't promised it.

sections.title: New today
sections.intro: Found Oct 10. Two are in LA at L'Oréal; #20 is the strongest fit.

sections.title: From earlier
sections.intro: Your Oct 9 top 10, in the same order. Every one was still open on Oct 10.

notes: SMCP Group: still nothing that fits. Its US openings are boutique roles plus a few New York office jobs (accounts receivable, allocation planning, executive assistant), none in marketing.
#2 (Youth To The People consumer engagement, El Segundo) is still open if you want another LA option, but it's focused on the US market.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Global Brand Partnerships (NYX Professional Makeup)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); NYX's global brand partnerships team.
jobs.why: Partnerships is the whole job: spotting collaboration ideas with fandoms, entertainment and communities, building partner proposals and presentations, and keeping timelines and approvals on track across partners and internal teams. It lists no minimum years, just experience in marketing, product development or project coordination, so your partner management at Gartner plus your marketing internships make this the most realistic new LA role. The posting doesn't say whether it's hybrid.

jobs.title: Coordinator, Social Media
jobs.french_tie: fresh is a global skincare brand within LVMH (Paris).
jobs.why: You'd support fresh's Global Marketing Communications team on global campaigns and launches, keeping global content calendars and reporting on social activations. It asks for 2 years of social media experience and counts internships, so your Windward and Madison Avenue Events internships and the Sensations social work all count. It's a coordinator-level role focused on social, so it's a step in rather than a step up.

jobs.title: Manager, TikTok Shop Content (Urban Decay)
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home)
jobs.why: An LA hybrid role that runs Urban Decay's TikTok content calendar and works with its creator and affiliate network, with webinars and live streams in the mix.
jobs.stretch_note: It asks for 3-5 years plus TikTok Shop experience, and you'd be shooting and editing short videos yourself.

jobs.title: Manager, Brand Marketing, Kiehl's US
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ), L'Oréal Luxe division; turns global brand guidelines into US plans.
jobs.why: Heavy on partnerships: campaigns, sponsorships, events and Kiehl's amenity programs with hotels and fitness clubs, coordinating partners and tracking results. Your partner management and event planning line up well.
jobs.stretch_note: It asks for at least 5 years of marketing or brand management, and you'd manage a direct report.

jobs.title: Retail Partnership Regional Manager, Northeast
jobs.french_tie: Cartier is a Paris maison founded in 1847, now part of the Swiss group Richemont.
jobs.travel: Not mentioned (the role travels up to 80% around the region)
jobs.why: This is the closest to what you do now: owning relationships with Cartier's retail partners, building action plans from their sales data, and planning CRM and events with them. It's on the commercial side rather than pure marketing, but it's a real partnerships role at a French luxury house.
jobs.stretch_note: It wants 2-3 years of key account management in luxury watches, eyewear, fragrance, automotive or cosmetics (prefers a Master's), and up to 80% travel.

jobs.title: Account-Based Marketing & Sales Activation Manager (B2B)
jobs.french_tie: Michelin is headquartered in Clermont-Ferrand, France; this is its North American HQ.
jobs.why: A marketing role built for someone who knows sales: picking priority accounts, running campaign kickoffs with sales teams, training them on Salesforce and prospecting tools, and reporting on pipeline. Your AE background is exactly the point of view it needs.
jobs.stretch_note: It asks for 3+ years in account-based marketing or sales enablement and in-depth experience with tools like 6sense or ZoomInfo, and it's outside LA.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Global Marketing (Youth To The People)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); on the brand's global team.
jobs.why: You'd be on the brand's global team, sharing the global strategy with country teams and running launches and sampling. It asks for 2+ years, so it's the most realistic LA role.
jobs.status: You're applying: tailored resume emailed Oct 10

jobs.title: Manager, Global Brand Marketing (NYX Professional Makeup)
jobs.why: A global brand team role built around community partnerships, campaigns and agency management. It asks for 2-5 years of brand marketing, so it's a bit of a reach, but your partnership work counts.

jobs.title: Associate Brand Manager, Shaver US & Canada
jobs.french_tie: BIC is a French company based just outside Paris.
jobs.why: This entry-level brand role works with global teams and asks for 1-3 years in marketing, brand or commercial roles, so your AE experience counts directly.

jobs.title: Trade Marketing Associate Manager, Erborian
jobs.work_arrangement: About 2 days a week in the office
jobs.french_tie: Part of L'Occitane Group, the Provence-born beauty group.
jobs.why: You'd be the day-to-day contact for Ulta and handle partnership opportunities. It asks for 2-3+ years with retail or strategic account partners, which is the closest match to what you do now.

jobs.title: Junior Global Trade Marketing Manager
jobs.french_tie: A smaller company that owns most of Interparfums SA in Paris.
jobs.why: You'd support global fragrance launches across international markets, and it asks for 2+ years of commercial marketing. The brands are mostly US-licensed (DKNY, Abercrombie), not French.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Social and Content (PPD DMI)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); global (DMI) team for the Professional Products Division, working with country teams.
jobs.why: It asks for 1-3 years, but the work is mostly social media content, so it fits best if you'd enjoy that.

jobs.title: Associate Brand Manager, Cointreau
jobs.french_tie: A mid-size, family-controlled French spirits group; the posting names the Global Brand Team as one of the teams you'd work with.
jobs.why: A real brand management role covering social, influencer partnerships, budget and agencies.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 2-4 years of brand marketing.

jobs.title: Associate Brand Manager, Moët & Chandon
jobs.french_tie: LVMH; you'd manage relationships with the Moët & Chandon house.
jobs.why: You'd run US programs and manage relationships with the Moët & Chandon house, POS work and agencies.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3-5 years of brand marketing in CPG or luxury.

jobs.title: Manager, Global Marketing, L'Oréal Paris DMI Cosmetics
jobs.work_arrangement: Up to 2 days a week from home
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); the most global role on the list.
jobs.why: You'd shape L'Oréal Paris's global makeup plans for the US and handle key country relationships.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3+ years of CPG or beauty marketing and product launch experience, so it's a real reach.

jobs.title: Press & Communications Manager
jobs.french_tie: A small Paris silver house founded in 1830, closer to the size you said you like.
jobs.why: The role covers press, events and partner messaging across North America.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3+ years of PR or communications experience.
